title: Scientific Engineering Institute passes to Searle, then Monsanto

tellings.quote: CIA's Scientific Engineering Institute was quietly transitioned into the private sector in the late 1970s.

plain: The CIA's Scientific Engineering Institute was quietly moved into the private sector in the late 1970s, Michels says, and the story as framed has it passing to the drug company Searle and then to the chemical giant Monsanto by the mid-1980s, with Donald Rumsfeld part of the picture. Michels tells it himself without naming a source, and if true it would mean CIA research quietly continued inside private drug and chemical firms.
